==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I am in a familiar store. I have dreamed of this store before, but I have never taken the time to log it. I originally thought it was mundane, but now I know better.

Whenever I dream of this store, a fee key things seem to always happen. I get the chance to buy something historical. Often something from another world, like an autograph from someone who doesn't exist.

The manager likes to give me puzzles. I often avoid playing them, because I can sense that there's something evil about them. What made this visit stand out, is that I had all my previous purchases and knew that I had been there before.
